questions.ask: What visual theme should the obby tower use (for example: bright colorful toy blocks, neon cyberpunk, fantasy ruins, or industrial)?

answers.ask: What visual theme should the obby tower use (for example: bright colorful toy blocks, neon cyberpunk, fantasy ruins, or industrial)?
answers.answer: Use a bright, colorful toy-block obby style so it is clear and immediately playable.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D obby map built as one continuous bright, colorful toy-block tower: a vertical course rising through stacked platform sections, with checkpoints along the climb and a finish at the top.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Obby & Platformer: the author explicitly requests a playable tower obby with a continuous climb and a top finish.

### Shape and preset
Use `course-tower`, a single vertical tower whose ordered platform route rises through stacked sections to the summit. Match the Tower Obby preset: its tower form, sequential climb, and summit reward remain recognisable; omit its unrequested timed and climb-specific obstacle assumptions.

### Config requirements
Use `path-track` as a clearly legible, continuous sequence of colorful toy-block platforms climbing from the base through the tower. Use `checkpoint-respawn` as bright, flat safe landing pads integrated between climb sections. Use `winner-zone` as a distinct celebratory finish platform at the tower’s top.

### Layout requirements
Place `checkpoint-respawn` markers at safe enclosed landing pads between major vertical sections, spaced regularly along the continuous ascent; the exact count is not specified. Place one `winner-zone` completion volume on the summit finish platform. No pickups, emitters, or other placed gameplay objects are requested.

### Layout components
Build one compact vertical course zone: a bright, colorful toy-block tower rising from a broad starting pad at the bottom to a visible finish platform at the top. The path is one uninterrupted upward chain of discrete, physics-legal jumping platforms, with each stacked section visibly feeding into the next rather than branching into separate routes. Checkpoint pads provide broad, calm resets between denser climbing stretches. Use saturated primary-color blocks, simple geometric platforms, chunky rails or decorative block framing where helpful, and open air around the ascent so the route is readable. The boundary is the tower footprint and its surrounding fall space; falling off the platform chain drops players out of the active route. Frame the full tower in an elevated isometric view, with the base and summit both readable and the upward path visibly spiralling or zig-zagging through the structure.

### Render order
Use `topdown`: the platform chain must remain connected and every critical jump must be physically legal, so a plan is authoritative before the isometric dressing.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Use a medium scale, driven by one complete tower with multiple stacked climb sections rather than a sprawling world. Theme: bright, colorful toy-block obby, clean and immediately readable. Apply `P6` because the jump route must be valid by construction, and `P2` because stacked tower platforms and sections vertically overhang one another.

LAYOUT FEATURES for this Obby & Platformer map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Tower / Spiral Ascent: A course wrapping or stacking so platforms sit directly above each other.

INCLUDE:
- Sequential Platform Track: A chain of platforms spaced to the physics limits above — the ordered route through the course.
- Safe Landing Pad: Flat enclosed pads set at intervals along the course, wide enough to stand on safely.
- End Reward Area: A distinct reward area at the end of the course holding the payoff items. Polished square Roblox-like 3D environment concept, isometric three-quarter view, no captions or watermark.
